smx019_gates.assertion: A browser author can create a Thing from blank canvas without engine/build vocabulary.
Timeline can animate a property but is not required for non-timeline interactive work.
A beginner Rule and advanced Behaviour target the same accepted execution semantics/IR.
Connections target stable declared ports rather than hierarchy paths.
An ordinary group can become a reusable local definition without replacing the first instance Thing IDs.
Play/stop/edit/play does not mutate authored canonical state merely by running.
Save/reload excludes selection, presence, peer/session handles and play-session context.
Publish/load uses a generic-player contract and does not require an author-operated per-creation build/export pipeline.
Simple multiplayer presets map to the same control/authority/replication/relevance semantics shown in advanced view and expose no transport/session IDs.
People/history/conflicts are visibly separate from runtime Play Together controls and transient presence is not canonical creation state.
Expected failures are expressible in author vocabulary; engine/toolchain terms in ordinary diagnostics are acceptance failures.
Import/replacement preserves stable AssetId and the complete immutable digest/source/audio/provenance revision bundle; no UI path synthesizes mixed provenance.
